action.description: Object-creation or scaffold operation to perform.

baseVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency versionToken for atomic create/update.

curl.description: curl_procedure: the curl command to import as a Procedure.

description.description: Human-readable description / title of the object.

expectedVersion.description: object_atomic update: optimistic concurrency token returned as `version` by a prior atomic create/update/read; a mismatch fails with ConcurrentModification instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

firstItem.description: object SDT optional: name of the first structure item to seed (SDK requires ≥1). Defaults to Item1. Use to avoid the throwaway Item1.

firstItemType.description: object SDT optional: type of the seeded first item (Character/Numeric/VarChar/…). Defaults to VarChar.

folder.description: object: Folder destination (created in Root, then moved+verified).

mode.description: object_atomic: create (fail if exists), update (fail if missing), auto (default — create or update by existence).

parentPath.description: object: folder/module destination (fallback when folder/module absent).

parms.description: object_atomic: parameter entries rendered into a Parm rule — bare names ("&Id") or prefixed ("out:&Msg").

properties.description: object_atomic: object-level properties applied via the genexus_properties path (propertyName → value).

rollbackOnFailure.description: Issue #60: with action=object and validationMode=specify, roll back the created object when the specify pass reports errors. A fresh object has no pre-write snapshot, so rollback reports rolledBack=false — delete it via genexus_delete_object if spec fails.

rules.description: object_atomic: rule lines (e.g. "Parm(in:&Id);"). Send actual line breaks; literal backslash sequences \r\n, \n, or \r are rejected before the first save.

source.description: object_atomic: Source part text. Send actual line breaks; literal backslash sequences \r\n, \n, or \r are rejected before the first save.

type.description: Object type to create (Transaction, Procedure, WebPanel, SDT, API, Domain, Dashboard, Folder, Module).

updateExisting.description: object_atomic: allow updating existing object if it already exists.

validationMode.description: Issue #60: with action=object, run the inline Specify pass (Spec+Gen, no Compile) after creation, returning structured spc*/gen* diagnostics in the same call. Combines with rollbackOnFailure.

variables.description: object_atomic: one object per variable — {varName, typeName?, length?, decimals?, collection?}. Validated before any save; errors are attributed to variables[N].

action.description: Operation to inspect, preview, create, update, or delete a native Data View mapping.

confirm.description: Required for action=delete when dryRun=false; explicitly authorizes removing the Transaction and Data View.

dataStore.description: Existing GeneXus data store category (default Default).

dataViewName.description: Data View name associated with the Transaction logical table.

dryRun.description: Forces every action to remain read-only; create/update validate their complete definition and delete returns a deletion preview.

expectedVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency token returned by inspect/dry_run/create/update/delete preview.

rollbackOnFailure.description: Atomic SDK rollback is always enforced; this flag records the caller's rollback intent.

table.description: Existing physical table and GeneXus table-metadata name.

tools.name: genexus_data_view

deep.description: reorg_impact/reorg_preview only: run ISpecifierService.ImpactDatabase (specification, build-heavy) for the authoritative AnalysisResult. Default false (cheap timestamp heuristic).

where.description: records_query/update: equality filters only; update requires a filter.

expectedVersion.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency token returned by a prior dry run.

tools.description: Edit object part. name or targets (exclusive). mode: full|patch|ops. dryRun first. async=true returns an operationId for lifecycle polling. Text payloads for Source/Rules/Events/Code must contain real line breaks; literal backslash sequences \r\n, \n, or \r are rejected before persistence with LiteralLineBreaksDetected. For WWP edit host's PatternInstance NOT the parent WebForm (gets overwritten on reapply). Uncertain about a property/method/event? → resources/read uri=genexus://kb/skills/navigation (or gam-integrated-security / sd-panel-mobile / webpanel-events) first.

async.description: Run as a background job. Result returns operationId/job_id for genexus_lifecycle polling.

autoDeclareVariables.description: When true, scans updated source for newly referenced &Variable tokens and auto-declares them in VariablesPart.

baseVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency: pass the versionToken from the genexus_read this edit is based on. If the object changed since (e.g. edited in the IDE), the write is refused with VersionConflict instead of overwriting the newer version. Omit to skip the check.

concurrencyPolicy.description: warn (default) or fail_if_open if open in GeneXus IDE.

context.description: Exact existing text to find (Replace) or anchor after (Insert_After). Required for both. For text parts, send real line breaks; literal backslash sequences \r\n, \n, or \r are rejected before persistence.

estimated_seconds.description: When async=true, expected runtime used for progress/job metadata (default 30).

expectedVersion.description: Alias of baseVersion. The write is refused when the current version no longer matches.

ops.description: GeneXus semantic ops (NOT RFC 6902 JSON-Patch). Each item: {op, args}. Supported ops: set_attribute, add_attribute, remove_attribute (Transaction); add_rule, remove_rule (Transaction/Procedure/WebPanel); set_property (any kind). Use mode=patch for textual find/replace.

args.description: Op-specific args. set_attribute: {name, type?, description?}. add_attribute: {name, type, ...}. add_rule: {rule}. set_property: {name, value}.

parts.description: Multi-part edit on a single object. Each item: {part, content, mode?}. Saves the object once atomically. Text content must use real line breaks; literal backslash sequences \r\n, \n, or \r are rejected before persistence.

patch.description: Shorthand for {find,replace}. Equivalent to operation=Replace + context=find + content=replace.

replaceAll.description: patch mode only. Apply to ALL occurrences instead of requiring expectedCount to match exactly.

rollbackOnFailure.description: Explicit rollback only: restore a valid pre-write snapshot when post-save verification or validationMode=specify fails. No rollback occurs when false or omitted.

validate.description: strict (default) aborts on first error and post-write-verifies visual/PatternInstance writes (re-reads + diffs the persisted XML). best-effort applies what compiles and SKIPS the post-write XML re-read/diff (faster on large WebForm/PatternInstance writes; build to confirm). only runs in-memory, no persist.

validationMode.description: Issue #60: run the inline Specify pass (Spec+Gen, no Compile) against the edited object right after the write, returning structured spc*/gen* diagnostics in the same call. Combines with rollbackOnFailure.

verifyMode.description: Post-save text comparison for patch mode. Source/Rules default to normalized (EOL, encoding marker, trailing whitespace and repeated blank lines); exact preserves logical text but treats CRLF/LF as the same SDK Source rendering; semantic also tolerates SDK casing/spacing format changes. Comment-only Replace writes require baseVersion and return CommentOnlyWriteNotPersisted on a divergent forced re-read. The part is always re-read after Save.

visualVerify.description: Post-edit headless screenshot + pixel-diff vs baseline. See tool-help.

tools.description: GxServer (Team Development) sync. Read: status|pending|ignored|conflicts|history. pending lists locally-changed objects, each flagged ignoredForCommit (true = in the IDE 'Ignored Objects' tab, skipped by a full commit). ignored lists ONLY the excluded objects: commitIgnored (IDE Commit > Ignored Objects) + updateIgnored (IDE Update > Ignored Objects). Write (destructive; requires a GXserver-linked KB): commit (message; optional targets[] = commit ONLY those pending objects; reports committedObjects + remoteVersion) | update (applies changes into local KB; apply=false = download only; leaves conflicts flagged) | lock (target) | resolve (targets[] + strategy). theirs/automerge/update talk to the server and need creds via GXMCP_TEAMDEV_USER/PASSWORD env (url auto-resolves). Returns {connected:false} when KB is not linked.

action.description: GXserver/Team Development or CI pipeline operation to perform.

force.description: commit: force commit despite pending server-side changes.

rebuild.description: pipeline_run: full rebuild instead of incremental.

runTests.description: pipeline_run: run tests as part of the pipeline.

strategy.description: resolve: which version wins — mine (keep local, default, creds-free), theirs (take server), automerge (3-way merge). theirs/automerge need server creds.

targets.description: commit: partial commit — object names to commit (all other pending objects are excluded). resolve: conflicted object names to resolve. Names must appear in action=pending/conflicts.

tools.name: genexus_module

tools.description: View navigation report (IDE Right-click → View Navigation). latest=true returns cached report from .gx/navigation-cache; else runs fresh.

action.description: Navigation report operation to execute.

latest.description: Return the most recent cached navigation if any; otherwise run fresh.

tools.name: genexus_navigation

tools.description: Read/update object properties. action=get|set|move. move snapshots every persisted part, checks baseVersion, verifies inside the SDK transaction and after commit, and rolls back divergence. Use destination for a Folder/Module or targetModule for a Module; destKind disambiguates equal names. dryRun does not save or change the token. Move never runs lifecycle, compilation, execution, or tests. Description is the WebPanel/Popup title-bar text. Use genexus_layout set_property for layout controls.

action.description: Object-property operation to read or change metadata or move the object.

baseVersion.description: move: opaque optimistic concurrency token returned by a prior read.

control.description: Optional. Layout control name (e.g. BtnConfirmar), variable name with & prefix (e.g. &Alu2RegProf), or attribute name.

destKind.description: move: disambiguate when a Folder and Module share a name.

dryRun.description: move: preview from/to and preserved parts without persisting.

properties.description: Batch set: map of propertyName to value applied in 1 transaction.

rollbackOnFailure.description: move: attempt compensating snapshot restoration if the SDK transaction rollback is insufficient (default true). set+validationMode=specify: request rollback after validation failure.

targetModule.description: move: typed alias for a Module destination.

validationMode.description: Issue #60: with action=set, run the inline Specify pass (Spec+Gen, no Compile) after the property write, returning structured spc*/gen* diagnostics in the same call. Combines with rollbackOnFailure.

tools.name: genexus_properties

tools.description: Search objects in active KB. Prefixes: name:, type:, usedby:, parent:, parentPath:, description:. name:"X" (or bare quoted "X") demands exact-name match — use it when you know the object's name. Compact by default. See genexus://kb/tool-help/genexus_query. Requires the KB index to be Ready — check genexus_lifecycle action=status if results look empty.

cursor.description: Opaque token from prior nextCursor. Use with sort=lastUpdate for stable paging.

modifiedBefore.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Only items with lastUpdate < modifiedBefore.

since.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Only items with lastUpdate >= since.

sort.description: relevance (default) or lastUpdate (newest first; bypasses score ranking).

tools.name: genexus_query

tools.description: Read object code and metadata. Omitting 'part' (RECOMMENDED) returns the COMPLETE object in 1 call (rules with parm, source/events, variables, structure, called signatures) tailored to the object type. Resolve modular objects by name/type, persisted GUID, EntityKey, or path. Pass 'part' only for targeted single-part reads. Response carries versionToken for safe writes. See genexus://kb/tool-help/genexus_read.

entityKey.description: Typed GeneXus EntityKey from genexus_list_objects verbose output.

parts.description: Selected parts; unavailable DataSelector parts appear in unsupportedParts. Mutually exclusive with part/offset/limit.

tools.name: genexus_read

tools.description: Named playbooks + self-extending macros. action=list|describe|suggest_macro|crystallize.

action.description: list: show recipes; describe: inspect recipe; suggest_macro: detect repeated sequences; crystallize: save sequence as recipe.

steps.description: crystallize: ordered array of tool call steps to include in the macro.

items.description: Tool call step object or template.

tools.name: genexus_recipe

tools.description: Run GeneXus refactor: rename, extract procedure, extract local subroutine, or WWP condition set. For KB-wide rename with call-site patching (RenameObject/RenameAttribute), the response includes a patched-site count from RefactorService. dryRun=true previews what would change without persisting.

action.description: Refactoring operation to execute; rename and extraction actions change KB source or metadata.

controlAttribute.description: WWPSetCondition: control or attribute name to attach condition.

dryRun.description: When true, returns what would be changed without persisting.

newName.description: New name for the renamed object, attribute, or variable.

objectName.description: RenameVariable: target object name containing the variable.

procedureName.description: ExtractProcedure: name for the newly created Procedure.

subroutineName.description: ExtractSubroutine: name for the newly created Subroutine.

target.description: Primary object or symbol to refactor.

type.description: RenameObject: object type (e.g. WebPanel, Transaction, Procedure) to disambiguate when several objects share the name — e.g. a WebPanel vs the same-named Table behind a Transaction. Ignored by RenameAttribute/RenameVariable.

tools.name: genexus_refactor

tools.description: Resolve runtime URL for an object (webRoot + aspx + encoded args). gamSession='auto'|{user,pass,...} captures GAM cookies. Does NOT open a browser. dryRun=true returns the resolved URL without performing GAM login.

dryRun.description: When true, returns the resolved URL without performing the GAM login step.

gamSession.description: 'auto' (use GXMCP_GAM_USER/PASS env) or {user, pass, repository?, loginUrl?}.

tools.name: genexus_run_object

tools.description: Dump SDK surface (types/methods/props) to docs/sdk-probe/. Use when hunting for entry points.
tools.name: genexus_sdk_probe

tools.description: Regex/semantic search across Procedure/DataProvider/WebPanel/Transaction source. Restrict a scan by object name, persisted GUID, EntityKey, or module/folder-qualified path. Requires the KB index to be Ready — check genexus_lifecycle action=status if results look empty.

argMatches.description: Positional arg index to expected literal text.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from nextCursor; preferred when a result page ended inside an object. Do not edit.

entityKey.description: Typed GeneXus EntityKey from genexus_list_objects verbose output.

fields.description: Whole-field metadata match (returns matchedValue, no line context). Default [source]. Prefer scope=[webForm] for line-context WebForm hits; use fields=[webForm] only for a coarse contains-match.

inline_read_top.description: 0-3. Inline reads of top N distinct objects in response.

objectName.description: Restrict the scan to these exact object name(s), comma-separated. Makes a search inside one known object O(object) not O(KB), and bypasses the type whitelist.

scope.description: Parts to scan with line-numbered context. Default [source]. webForm/layout scans the WebPanel/Transaction visual XML (control names, captions, classes, bindings).

startIndex.description: Legacy object-boundary resume. For a page that ended inside an object, prefer the opaque cursor returned in nextCursor.

timeoutMs.description: Wall-clock budget (default 30000). Raise it to scan more objects per call.

tools.name: genexus_search_source

tools.description: Audit KB security. action=audit_gam scans GAM/env props; action=scan_secrets greps Source for credential-shaped literals; action=scan_native drives the native GeneXus Security Scanner (ISecurityScannerService). Returns findings with severity.

action.description: audit_gam: scans GAM and environment properties; scan_secrets: greps Source for credentials; scan_native: drives native GeneXus Security Scanner.

tools.name: genexus_security

tools.description: Read or write the structure/data-model of GeneXus objects. update_visual now snapshots every part, checks optimistic concurrency, saves and re-reads the Transaction, and restores the complete snapshot when persistence or authored-part verification fails. Default form projections are allowed to follow Structure; user-authored forms are invariant. No structure action implicitly runs Specify, Generate, Build, Rebuild, compilation, reorganization, execution, or tests. Other actions cover indexes, attributes (set_attribute operates on global attribute definitions; use update_visual/move_attribute/remove_attribute for Transaction structure), levels, Domains (including enumValues), SubType Groups and subtype consistency (check_subtypes). For layout control trees use genexus_layout.

action.description: Structure operation to execute.

after.description: move_attribute: place attribute after this attribute in the same level. Mutually exclusive with before/position.

attribute.description: move_attribute: existing attribute to reorder by native SDK identity.

baseVersion.description: Optimistic-concurrency token for update_visual/move_attribute/create_index. Stale state returns VersionConflict before mutation.

before.description: move_attribute: place attribute before this attribute in the same level. Mutually exclusive with after/position.

dryRun.description: update_visual/move_attribute/create_index: validate and return the projected diff without changing any object, Attribute, hash, or version.

level.description: move_attribute: root (default) or an unambiguous subordinate level name.

name.description: Object name. update_visual/move_attribute: Transaction name; create_index/get_indexes: Transaction or Table name.

payload.description: update_visual (Transaction):{children:[...]}; update_visual (SDT):{isCollection?,collectionItemName?,children:[{name,type?,length?,decimals?,basedOnDomain?,basedOnAttribute?,isCollection?,isLevel?,children?}]}. update_group:{members:[{name,subtypeOf}],remove?:[name]}. create_index:{attributes:["Attr"],unique?:true,name?,order?:"Ascending"|"Descending"}. Other actions keep their existing typed payloads.

position.description: move_attribute: zero-based final attribute position in the level. Mutually exclusive with before/after.

rollbackOnFailure.description: update_visual, move_attribute and create_index capture snapshots and verify rollback after any save or re-read divergence.

type.description: Optional object type disambiguator (e.g. 'Transaction', 'Table') when multiple objects share the same name.

validationMode.description: Explicitly run the inline Specify pass after selected writes. Never runs unless requested.

tools.name: genexus_structure

tools.description: Observability umbrella. action: executions (recent invocations) | watch_event (ops mentioning an event) | friction_append|friction_tail (.gx/friction.jsonl) | learning_report (aggregate friction) | logs (worker_debug.log tail) | profile_analyze|profile_hotspots|profile_correlate (GeneXus profiler XML).

action.description: Telemetry, profiling, or friction-log operation to perform.

event.description: watch_event: event name to match in operation payload.

grep.description: logs: substring filter on log lines.

message.description: friction_append: description of the friction encountered.

n.description: friction_tail: number of recent lines to return.

path.description: profile_*: path to the GeneXus profiler XML file.

tail.description: logs: number of tail lines from worker_debug.log.

tool.description: friction_append: tool name that produced the friction entry.

top.description: profile_hotspots: top-N hottest procedures to return.

tools.name: genexus_telemetry

tools.description: Execute native GeneXus tests (GXtest).
tools.name: genexus_test

tools.description: Real XPZ export/import over the SDK's IKnowledgeManagerService — dependency-aware, IDE Export/Import parity (NOT the filesystem copy genexus_io/kb_import do). action=export (targets[]+outputFile; includeDependencies=true exports transitive closure) | inspect (explore an .xpz, read-only) | import (apply into KB; dryRun defaults true=preview via ExploreExport; dryRun=false requires confirm=true).

action.description: XPZ export, inspection, or import operation to perform.

dryRun.description: import: true (default) previews; false applies (needs confirm).

includeDependencies.description: export: compute transitive dependency closure (Calls, Tables) and export all referenced objects.

tools.name: genexus_transfer

tools.description: Variables CRUD. add accepts varName or variables[] batch; modify changes type atomically. basedOn binds a Domain by native SDK identity. objectType=BusinessComponent with objectName+module binds a modular BC by EntityKey/GUID and verifies it after save. length/decimals override size; collection=true declares a collection; untyped add inherits a same-named attribute. dryRun validates and previews without mutation; async returns an operationId.

action.description: Variable-part operation to add, delete, or modify a variable.

async.description: Run as a background job. Result returns operationId/job_id for genexus_lifecycle polling.

collection.description: add/modify optional: declare the variable as a collection.

decimals.description: add/modify optional: overrides decimals parsed from typeName.

dryRun.description: Validate and return the typed diff without changing any object, Attribute, hash, or version.

estimated_seconds.description: When async=true, expected runtime used for progress/job metadata (default 30).

expectedVersion.description: Optimistic-concurrency token for an object-backed add/modify. Stale state returns VersionConflict before mutation.

length.description: add/modify optional: overrides the length parsed from typeName.

module.description: Module owning objectName. Required to disambiguate modular Business Components.

objectName.description: Business Component Transaction name, without module when module is passed separately.

objectType.description: add/modify: resolve an object-backed variable natively instead of interpreting typeName as a Domain.

rollbackOnFailure.description: Object-backed variables always snapshot the complete owner and restore it on save/re-read divergence.

typeName.description: Primitive (Character/Numeric/VarChar/Date/...), SDT/BC/Domain name, or WebSession. VarChar keeps VARCHAR semantics.

validationMode.description: Explicitly run the inline Specify pass after a legacy variable write. Never runs unless requested.

varName.description: Single-variable form (add/delete/modify). For batch add use variables[] instead.

variables.description: Batch add only: one object per variable — {varName, typeName?, length?, decimals?, collection?}. Added before a single save.

tools.name: genexus_variable

tools.description: Versioning umbrella. action: history_list|history_get|history_save|history_restore (snapshot store; restore+discard=true is IDE 'Discard changes' parity) | undo (revert last N edits) | time_travel (recover bytes from a past git commit) | blame (git blame an object part) | diff (text: mode=textVsText|currentVsText) | diff_generated (against=last-build|git-head).

action.description: History, diff, time-travel, or rollback operation to perform.

discard.description: history_restore: true for IDE 'Discard changes' parity.

dryRun.description: history_restore/undo: preview without mutating the KB.

filePath.description: blame: absolute or KB-relative file path.

left.description: diff: left-side text or snapshot label.

name.description: Object name for history, diff, time_travel, or blame.

part.description: Object part name, e.g. Source, Rules, Events.

right.description: diff: right-side text or snapshot label.

snapshot.description: history_restore: snapshot label or path to restore.

tools.name: genexus_versioning

tools.description: KB context + version + health (worker/index/database) + next-step hints. Call FIRST every session. Lean by default; pass verbose=true ONCE for the inline playbooks + skills catalog of verified GeneXus reference resources (navigation, GAM, SD panel, WebPanel events). For a minimal connection+index health check use genexus_doctor.

verbose.description: Include the static playbooks + skills catalog + per-tool stats/heatmap. Default false (lean health payload).

tools.name: genexus_whoami

tools.description: Reload worker. modes: soft (drain+respawn), hard (copy sourceDir+respawn). force=true: gateway kills directly. See tool-help.

force.description: Bypass drain; gateway kills + respawns. Use when worker is wedged.

tools.name: genexus_worker_reload

tools.description: WorkWithPlus Action Group / grid-action editing (issue #58). action=list (read-only) lists the PatternInstance's action containers and their <userAction>/<standardAction> children; add_action adds a custom userAction to an existing or new group (procedure existence verified, selection single|multiple, enabledWhen condition, icon, description, confirm, position); update_action changes those attributes; move_action relocates an action between groups or reorders it; remove_action deletes an action (confirm=true). dryRun=true returns the XML diff without persisting. Edits target the WorkWithPlus host's PatternInstance XML (survives pattern reapply). NEVER creates Security/GAM permissions. Attributes are passed verbatim to the WWP XML; the SDK's own save normalization is reported honestly via the pattern write verification.

action.description: WorkWithPlus action-group or grid-action operation to perform.

confirm.description: add/update: confirmation prompt; remove_action: required to delete (unless dryRun).

dryRun.description: Return the XML diff without persisting (default false).

enabledWhen.description: add/update: availability condition text (e.g. 'MonitorIntegracaoStatus = DSituacaoProcessamento.Suspenso'). Stored verbatim; expression semantics are not validated.

fromGroup.description: move_action: source group (optional; searched across groups when omitted).

group.description: Action group/container name (TableActions row). add_action: creates a new group when absent; update/remove: scope filter.

position.description: add/move/update: zero-based index among the group's actions.

procedure.description: add/update: associated Procedure; existence is validated against the KB.

selection.description: add/update: execution scope for grid actions.

tools.name: genexus_wwp
